0022600139.text: The Timberwolves host the Warriors in Minnesota's fifth game of the season, and they come in at 3-1 (1-0 at home), third in the Northwest and one game back, sixth in the West, after a loss in their most recent game. Golden State is 1-3 (0-1 at home), fourth in the Pacific and 2.5 games back, 12th in the West, and it won its most recent game. Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), while Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness), and Moses Moody (out, knee surgery), and Yaxel Lendeborg is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 127-117 win in San Francisco on March 13, 2026.
